```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
```


```{r}
#| cache: true
billboard <- read_csv("data/billboard.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
```

```{r}
songs <- billboard |>
  pivot_longer(
    starts_with("wk"),
    names_to = "week",
    values_to = "rank",
    values_drop_na = TRUE
  ) |>
  mutate(week = parse_number(week)) |>
  group_by(artist, track) |>
  summarize(
    first_rank = rank[week == 1],
    best_rank = min(rank),
    best_week = min(week[rank == min(rank)]),
    weeks_on_chart = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

number_ones <- songs |> filter(best_rank == 1)

bind_rows(
  number_ones |> slice_min(best_week, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |> mutate(label = "Fastest to #1"),
  number_ones |> slice_max(best_week, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |> mutate(label = "Slowest to #1"),
  songs |> filter(best_rank <= 10) |> slice_max(weeks_on_chart, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |> mutate(label = "Longest top-10 run")
) |>
  select(label, artist, track, first_rank, best_rank, best_week, weeks_on_chart)
```

```{r}
top10 <- billboard |>
  pivot_longer(
    starts_with("wk"),
    names_to = "week",
    values_to = "rank",
    values_drop_na = TRUE
  ) |>
  mutate(week = parse_number(week)) |>
  group_by(artist, track) |>
  filter(min(rank) <= 10) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(song = paste0(artist, ": ", track))

highlight <- top10 |>
  filter(song %in% c("Madonna: Music", "Lonestar: Amazed", "Creed: Higher"))

ggplot() +
  geom_line(data = top10, aes(x = week, y = rank, group = song),
            color = "gray80") +
  geom_line(data = highlight, aes(x = week, y = rank, color = song),
            linewidth = 1.2) +
  scale_y_reverse() +
  labs(
    title = "Three Different Paths Through the Top 10",
    subtitle = "All top-10 songs in gray, three notable hits in color",
    x = "Weeks on the Chart",
    y = "Rank (1 = best)",
    color = "Song"
  )
```
